_note: UV-A3 audit of every gtceu:fusion_reactor recipe the Mk3 (gtceu:uv_fusion_reactor) can run: EU/t at most VA[UV] and eu_to_start within 16 energy hatches x 40 M EU = 640 M (UV-S0 S0-4: a 640 M start runs on a formed Mk3 and is refused on the Mk2; the 30 recipes loaded at the time all fit). The Mk3 inherits every recipe LuV and ZPM audited (fusion_mk1.json, fusion_mk2.json) and adds the six GTM recipes above 320 M, which only it can run. fate: keep (the Mk3 runs it as GTM has it), luv_cut (removed by LuV-B10, decision 6; stays removed, so absent from the live manager; listed so the audit does not flag it as unaudited if it ever returns; UV-S0's decision to 'keep the three extra recipes' is read as 'list them', not 'restore them'). ours: none (UV adds no Mk3 recipe of its own; the chamber's fuel is the laser fusion type). mk3Only: the six start-above-320 M recipes (the 'beyond' list of fusion_mk2.json). server_scripts/grindless/uv/fusion.js reads this table; a recipe of the type that the Mk3 could run and that is neither listed here nor ours is logged as unaudited. The figures of eut and start are GTM's (with GTCA's oganesson and Pu-241 + hydrogen), except duranium, whose start is LuV's 200 M re-registration (tables/fusion_mk1.json).
